What you are paying for

Not more tools.
Better flow.

You are not paying for a list of software subscriptions. You are paying for the connections, improvements and habits that make the tools you already have work as one process.

Your website, lead journey and workflows keep changing as the business grows. Monthly work is planned around the improvements that matter most, rather than waiting until the business is forced into another expensive rebuild.

01

A stronger customer journey

We improve the path from first visit or enquiry to the next useful action, whether that is a WhatsApp conversation, a booking, a sale or a qualified lead in your CRM.

02

Less repeated work

We automate practical handoffs, notifications, reporting and follow-up so staff spend less time moving information between tools.

03

Connected business systems

We make the website, forms, CRM, calendar, payments, WhatsApp and reporting tools work together more clearly.

04

A team that can use it

We provide training and guidance so your people understand what has changed and how to use it with confidence.

Ongoing work

What a monthly partnership looks like.

Four things happen every month, whether or not anything has gone wrong.

01

Prioritise

We agree the most useful work for the month based on business priorities, live issues and the existing roadmap.

02

Build, connect or improve

We use the agreed capacity to deliver the work: improving a page, refining a lead flow, building an automation, connecting systems, improving reporting or training the team.

03

Review

You receive a plain-language update explaining what changed, what was learned, what needs a decision and what we recommend next.

04

Plan ahead

Growth and Transformation plans include regular forward planning so work supports the next business priority rather than only responding to requests.

Clear terms

Clear capacity.
Clear ownership.

Monthly work is defined by capacity and agreed priorities. Any task outside the scope, capacity or active roadmap is estimated and approved before work begins.

After the initial Founding Partner period or another agreed initial term, plans run month to month and may end with 30 days' written notice.

Your business retains ownership of its domains, accounts, source files and data.

Hosting, domains, CRM licences, automation-platform subscriptions, AI-tool subscriptions, paid plugins, payment-processing fees, advertising spend and other third-party costs are billed separately unless a written proposal says otherwise.

Common questions

Simple answers before you start.

Do you take on one-off projects?+

No. Dakyworld works on monthly partnerships only. A website build, an integration or an automation is delivered as the early priorities of a partnership, so the work keeps improving after launch rather than being handed over and left.

We need a new website. Where does that sit?+

Inside the partnership. The build becomes the first priority on your roadmap and is delivered through the monthly capacity, with the plan chosen to match the size of the build. Your proposal states what will be live, and by when.

Are these plans really month to month?+

Yes, after the initial Founding Partner period or any other period agreed in your proposal. You may end the arrangement with 30 days' written notice.

What counts as routine website work?+

Examples include agreed content updates, page refinements, conversion improvements and minor changes within your monthly allocation. New sections, major redesigns, additional websites and complex features are separately scoped.

Can you support every tool we use?+

No. Each proposal names the systems Dakyworld will work on. We focus on the website, workflows, automations and connections most relevant to the agreed business goals.

Will we receive a proposal before work begins?+

Yes. Your proposal states the outcome, scope, responsibilities, exclusions, timeline, investment, monthly capacity and third-party costs.

Who owns our accounts and work?+

Your business retains ownership of its domains, platform accounts, source files and data. Dakyworld receives only the access needed to complete agreed work.

Can you build a custom plan?+

Yes. Transformation engagements are built around your systems, priorities, stakeholders and required delivery capacity.
